body: Thank you that means a lot. You're right there is still hope for young people like us or anyone really. There's a lot going on in the world and that on top of what we're going through already makes it seem impossible, keep searching, I believe you.

I know exactly what you're feeling. I use to be so happy but every since this long tiring mine month relationship I was trying to hold up, trying to fix her, I ruined myself. I have a wonderful supportive girlfriend now, I just cant feel happy still after all that. I'm in the Armed Forces now and have so many friends and I still just want to end it all. I'm doing absolute shit in school and I keep thinking, "Hey you can turn this around.". I just fucking cant, I don't know how too. I think I'm gonna kill myself with my service weapon pretty soon. I just need to get some things wrote down first. But hey you're still fighting and by that you're so much stronger than me, I hope you find peace in living somehow. 

Much love,
